# Intent-DNS

> Authoritative DNS hosting with apex ALIAS support and a REST API on every plan. Free tier covers 20 domains with 1,000 records each.

Intent-DNS hosts DNS zones on anycast nameservers. Its distinguishing feature is
ALIAS: a record type that lets a zone apex point at a hostname, which plain DNS
forbids because the apex must also carry SOA and NS records.

## Start here

- [Pricing](https://dns.int.yt/pricing): free ($0, 20 domains), paid ($1/mo, 100 domains), unlimited ($4/mo)
- [DNS record types](https://dns.int.yt/dns-records): A, AAAA, ALIAS, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, NS, CAA with zone-file examples
- [Control panel](https://panel.dns.int.yt/): manage zones and records
- [REST API reference](https://panel.dns.int.yt/api-docs.php): endpoints and schemas

## Delegation

Point a domain at these nameservers:

- `dns1.int.yt`
- `dns2.int.yt`

Both resolve to `192.255.149.52`, an anycast address.

## API

Base URL: `https://dns.int.yt/api/v1`

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

- `POST /auth/token` — exchange credentials for a token
- `GET /user` — account and plan limits
- `GET|POST /domains` — list or create zones
- `GET|DELETE /domains/{id}` — read or delete a zone
- `GET|POST /domains/{id}/records` — list or create records
- `PUT|DELETE /domains/{id}/records/{record_id}` — replace or delete a record
